subject: Post-call: Novamed SDK integration — owners, deps & target close
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novamed.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 20:03:00 -0400
Subject: Post-call: Novamed SDK integration — owners, deps & target close

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we don't lose momentum. I attached an updated MAP draft and a focused integration build plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs).

Key recap
- Win condition: embed Redwood streaming SDK for real-time patient note summaries + tool-calling to query Novamed patient DB for structured fields.
- Minimal viable integration scope (MVP): SDK embed in backend -> streaming responses for live UI -> tool-call for patient lookup -> produce structured JSON outputs mapped to Novamed schema.

Requested confirmations (can you reply inline?)
1) Owners: please confirm the Novamed engineer who will be the technical owner for the SDK build (we have tentatively listed Priya).
2) Dependencies: confirm the timeline for the API key rotation and data access ACLs (you mentioned a security review this week).
3) Target close for commercial terms: we set a tentative close of 2027-07-12 in the MAP draft — OK?

What we attached / next internal owners
- Novamed_MAP_v0.2.xlsx — MAP milestones + target dates.
- SDK-buildplan-streaming-toolcalls-v1.pdf — build tasks, suggested owners on our side (Ben / Hannah), and risk flags.

Proposed next immediate step: 30-min technical sync with Priya + Ben + Hannah this Friday to walk through the streaming SDK handshake and tool-call auth. Ben, can you lead the demo and outline required artifacts?

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call: Novamed SDK integration — owners, deps & target close

Jordan — thanks for the clear notes and the attachments. Quick answers inline:

1) Owners: confirmed — Priya is our technical lead for this (she owns integrations). I'm copying our contracts mailbox for any procurement items.
2) Dependencies: security review is scheduled for Thursday 17th; API key rotation is expected to finish by next Tuesday 22nd, but we may fast-track if needed. We'll confirm after Thursday.
3) Target close: 2027-07-12 is fine from a stakeholder buy-in perspective but depends on procurement turnaround (contracts/PO).

Two clarifying items from our architects:
- Streaming: we need explicit latency SLOs for prefix streaming vs full response; can Redwood provide a recommended config for 95th percentile latency under 50ms for 256-token prefixes?
- Tool-calls: authentication model — we prefer short-lived signed tokens (Service A) vs long-lived API keys. Can Ben share how the SDK supports signed token exchange and automatic refresh?

We'll plan for the Friday sync — Priya is available 10:00–12:00 ET. Liam

Liam O'Connor
Director of Product Integrations | Novamed Systems
liam.oconnor@novamed.com | +1 617-555-2234

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 21:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novamed SDK integration — owners, deps & target close

Liam / team — thanks, noted. I pulled the attached build plan together; below are concrete answers and an updated owner map.

Owner assignments (Redwood-facing)
- SDK integration lead: Ben Carter (backend + SDK embed)
- Streaming & latency tuning: Hannah Schmitt (runtime configs, batching, SLOs)
- Tool-calling / auth workflows: Marissa Cole (security + token exchange patterns)
- PM/coordination: Jordan Blake

Answers to tech Qs
- Latency SLOs: we can provide a recommended configuration for 95th %ile <50ms for 256-token prefixes on our Dedicated tier with 2x NPU burst enabled. I'll attach a perf snippet to the Friday deck.
- Token model: the SDK supports short-lived signed tokens via a simple mutual-TLS handshake or signed JWT exchange. We recommend signed JWTs + refresh endpoint (we'll share code snippets).

Friday sync: Ben/Hannah/Marissa can do a 30-min walkthrough at 11:00 ET Friday (confirmed). Agenda: handshake demo (10m), streaming SLOs + sample config (10m), auth/token exchange pattern + sample snippet (10m), follow-up actions.

Risk flags
- Procurement turnaround is the main schedule risk. If contracts slip >2 weeks we should rebaseline MAP milestones.
- API access (read-only vs PII scope) — coordinate with your security team; Marissa will prepare a list of required scopes.

Next steps for Friday
- Ben to share sample signed JWT workflow and perf snippet by EOD Thursday.
- Priya to confirm who from Novamed will attend the sync and whether security will join.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

All — appreciate the quick replies. Confirming the MAP updates I made after Ben's owner list:
- MAP milestone: "Integration build complete (SDK + streaming + tool-calls)" — target 2027-07-05 (internal demo).
- Commercial close: leave 2027-07-12 as contract target (procurement buffer).
- Owners: Priya (Novamed) technical owner; Ben (Redwood) SDK lead; Hannah (Redwood) runtime/latency; Marissa (Redwood) security/token flows; Jordan (Redwood) overall exec sponsor.

Action items (short list)
- Priya: confirm security reviewer attendance for Thursday.
- Ben: provide JWT sample + perf snippet by Thu EOD.
- Marissa: publish required scopes list and a redlined minimal access matrix (will attach to the MAP).
- Jordan: send calendar invite for Friday 11:00 ET tech sync and update MAP with these owners.

If procurement needs a statement of work or a clarifying technical appendix, we can prepare a 1-page addendum to the proposal — flag here and we'll draft.

Thanks —
